scope: Descriptive illustration rule declared before any native confirmation outcome exists; it changes no metric, denominator, policy or inference. Complete request tables remain accompanying evidence.
harmful_case_rule: Select lexicographically first request_id among record-lookup questions that are full-correct and slice-wrong in every repetition. If none exists, select lexicographically first such harmful request across all families. If no repeated harmful request exists, report no qualifying illustration.
beneficial_case_rule: Select lexicographically first request_id that is full-wrong and slice-correct in every repetition. If none exists, report no qualifying illustration.
retained_material: Original prompt; selected prompt; expected answer; all repetitions and native output texts; selected/closure record indices; original attempt and trace hashes; independent interpreter check.
no_selection_effect: Figures and numerical results retain every offered question and all four classes. Illustrations do not establish frequencies or population effects.
